criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Order & Delivery
categories.definition: Inquiries about ordering a new card, its delivery status, or expedited shipping.

categories.name: Card Activation & Linking
categories.definition: Questions or issues related to activating a new card or linking it to an account or app.

categories.name: Card Usage & Features
categories.definition: Questions about how to use a card, its features, accepted locations, or virtual/disposable card options.

categories.name: Card Declined & Malfunction
categories.definition: Issues where a card is not working, declined for payments, or malfunctioning.

categories.name: Lost, Stolen, or Compromised Card
categories.definition: Reporting a lost, stolen, or compromised card and seeking assistance.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered at an ATM, such as card retention, incorrect cash dispensing, or withdrawal failures.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Requests to change, reset, unblock, or inquire about a card PIN.

categories.name: Card Replacement & Expiration
categories.definition: Inquiries about card expiration, renewal, or ordering a replacement card.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an account.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions or issues related to verifying identity for account access or features.

categories.name: Personal Details Update
categories.definition: Requests to update personal information associated with an account.

categories.name: Login & App Access Issues
categories.definition: Problems logging into the app or accessing account features.

categories.name: General Account Information
categories.definition: General questions about the bank's services, locations, eligibility, or general fees.

categories.name: Money Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending money, such as failed, pending, or delayed transfers.

categories.name: Money Transfer Fees & Limits
categories.definition: Questions about fees, limits, or charges related to sending or receiving money.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes & Unrecognized Charges
categories.definition: Reporting unauthorized, unrecognized, or incorrect transactions and charges.

categories.name: Transaction Reversal & Cancellation
categories.definition: Requests to reverse or cancel a recent transaction.

categories.name: Source of Funds Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about the origin or verification of funds in an account.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems with adding money to an account, such as failed, reverted, or pending top-ups, or questions about top-up limits and verification.

categories.name: How to Top-Up/Add Money
categories.definition: Questions about methods, currencies, or auto-top-up features for adding money to an account.

categories.name: Top-Up Fees
categories.definition: Questions about fees or charges associated with topping up an account.

categories.name: Currency Exchange Rates & Fees
categories.definition: Inquiries about currency exchange rates, fees, or conversion issues.

categories.name: Currency Options
categories.definition: Questions about available currencies or multi-currency account options.

categories.name: Refund Status & Process
categories.definition: Inquiries about the status or process of a refund for a purchase.
